name: feature-grid
title: Feature grid
description: A titled band of three to nine features, each an icon, a short heading and one sentence, in a grid that reflows by itself.

frame.summary: Intro above, items below as a <ul> grid. Items are not Cards: a feature is a sentence with an icon, not a widget, and a box around each one adds edges without adding meaning.

regions.name: items
regions.collapse: auto-fill: the column count follows the space, down to one.

components.name: heading
components.for: Section heading (base) and each feature's heading (base+1).

components.name: card
components.for: Future cards variant only, for navigable feature tiles.

dependsOnFuture.interim: Ships without per-item links; the slot is added when Link lands.

dependsOnFuture.for: A future `variant="cards"` for feature tiles that are themselves navigable.
dependsOnFuture.interim: Only the plain list variant ships. No <div className="card"> stand-in.

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of the section heading; everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

items.type: Array<{ icon: LucideIcon; title: ReactNode; description: ReactNode; href?: string }>
dont: Fewer than three — that is a sentence in the hero. More than nine — split into two bands with their own headings.

behavior.summary: Static composition. The grid is intrinsic: no breakpoint is involved.

decisions.decision: Items are a list, not a set of Cards
decisions.why: CLAUDE.md's frame table: Card is for widgets and galleries. A feature is prose; boxing it adds four edges per item and no affordance, and a box that is not clickable reads as though it should be.

decisions.decision: auto-fill grid with the playground gallery's tile minimum
decisions.why: That precedent already solved "count follows the space" without breakpoint tokens, including the min(…, 100%) guard against overflow at the narrowest widths.
The feature heading names the feature; an icon with its own label would be read twice.

landmarks.label: aria-labelledby the block's own heading (the section heading)

obligations: Icons are aria-hidden; the item's heading carries the meaning.

steps.change: As many columns as the track minimum allows — typically three.

native.reason: Marketing composition. A native app is reached after install, so there is nothing to persuade or convert; the equivalent content in-app is an onboarding or paywall screen, which is a different block with different obligations.

tokenGaps.need: A page content max-inline-size (container width) for marketing bands
tokenGaps.interim: The band's content box is capped at calc(var(--rata-size-control-lg) * 32) and centred with auto inline margins; the playground's own column cap is a literal with a comment saying there is no measure token. Open decision: a size.container.* role via the design-tokens skill, or keep deriving from the control scale.

tokenGaps.need: A section-band vertical padding step larger than space.section for marketing rhythm
tokenGaps.interim: padding-block uses var(--rata-space-section) top and bottom. space.section is the only page-rhythm step and was sized for docs pages, not full-bleed marketing bands.

tokenGaps.need: A grid gutter role (column and row gap between tiles)
tokenGaps.interim: gap: var(--rata-space-gap-lg) between tiles, var(--rata-space-stack-lg) between rows when they wrap. space.gap.* is documented for inline items, not grid gutters.

openQuestions: Should the icon sit in a tinted circle (theme.accent-role.subtle)? That is a new visual treatment and would need its own token recipe approval.
